verdict.rationale: Crossmint's evidence covers single-item flows (single wallet creation, single order intents, single checkout, single onramp/offramp orders) but never documents a bulk/batch API for processing many items (e.g., wallets, mints, payments) in one call. Bulk operations are a plausible axis for a wallet/payments infrastructure API, but no evidence pack item describes batch endpoints, bulk minting, or multi-item transaction support.
